articles.headline: Nvidia buys Hugging Face in $12.9bn deal
articles.summary: Nvidia’s acquisition of Hugging Face signals deeper consolidation in the AI stack and stronger control over open-source model distribution. For businesses, this could affect vendor choice, developer tooling, and the economics of deploying AI at scale.

articles.headline: OpenAI begins phased rollout of GPT-6 Astra to select organizations
articles.summary: A phased enterprise rollout suggests another jump in model capability for automation, content generation, and internal assistants. Businesses should expect rapid experimentation, but also more pressure to update policies for data handling, accuracy checks, and model governance.

articles.headline: Google Workspace adds new automation and AI features for business users
articles.summary: Google expanded Workspace with more automation steps, broader Gemini custom instructions, and new enterprise workflow tools. These updates matter for firms looking to reduce manual work, connect internal systems, and standardize AI use across teams.
